e9-chess-input-corr.label: correlation of Stockfish's monthly log test runs and log CPU-years

e9-chess-lr-p.label: p-value of the likelihood-ratio test of lambda against 0 for Stockfish

e9-chess-placebo-gain.label: log-likelihood the real test-run input gains over the smooth-trend placebo for Stockfish (1.92 would mark a 95% difference)

e9-chess-placebo-r.label: r for Stockfish when the input is replaced by a smooth trend growing at the input's own rate (a placebo)

e9-chess-r.label: r for Stockfish, test runs as the input, our one-step refit with Student-t noise (close to the authors' stable noise)
e9-chess-r.note: a smooth placebo input with the same growth gives nearly the same r, so the value rests on the two trends

e9-chess-r-above1.label: share of the Stockfish bootstrap refits with r above 1

e9-chess-r-hi.label: r for Stockfish, 95th percentile of 200 bootstrap refits over steps

e9-chess-r-lo.label: r for Stockfish, 5th percentile of 200 bootstrap refits over steps

e9-chess-r-subset-max.label: r for Stockfish: highest across the same five subsets

e9-chess-r-subset-min.label: r for Stockfish: lowest across five subsets of steps (before and after NNUE, halves, largest steps removed)

e9-chess-share.label: CPU-years' share of Stockfish's research input that fits best (test runs the rest), on a grid of 0.05

e9-chess-share-hi.label: highest CPU-years share within the 95% likelihood-ratio region for Stockfish

e9-chess-share-lo.label: lowest CPU-years share within the 95% likelihood-ratio region for Stockfish

e9-chess-share-r-hi.label: r for Stockfish: highest across the CPU-years shares within the 95% region

e9-chess-share-r-lo.label: r for Stockfish: lowest across the CPU-years shares within the 95% region

e9-chess-share-span.label: spread of the profile log-likelihood across CPU-years shares 0 to 1 for Stockfish (1.92 marks a 95% difference)

e9-chess-steps.label: Stockfish steps between consecutive Elo measurements in the fit

e9-cv-gk.label: growth of training compute in computer vision over the same window (notable models, natural log a year), the compute proxy

e9-cv-gk-se.label: standard error of that compute growth for computer vision

e9-cv-k-fixed.label: loop gain at fixed compute for computer vision, K = (1 - a) r, at compute's share a = 0.67, with compute's historical growth counted

e9-cv-k-fixed-above1.label: share of draws for computer vision with the fixed-compute loop gain above 1 at a = 0.67

e9-cv-k-fixed-hi.label: loop gain at fixed compute for computer vision at a = 0.67, 95th percentile of the draws

e9-cv-k-spec-max.label: loop gain at fixed compute for computer vision at a = 0.67: highest value across all specifications

e9-cv-r-labour.label: r for computer vision, our refit with research labour as the only input: steady-state ratio of output growth to input growth (today's OpenAlex counts, yearly flows, fitted slope)

e9-cv-r-labour-above1.label: share of the labour-only draws for computer vision with r above 1

e9-cv-r-labour-hi.label: r for computer vision, labour only, 95th percentile of the same draws

e9-cv-r-labour-lo.label: r for computer vision, labour only, 5th percentile of draws over the output trend's uncertainty and the input slope

e9-cv-r-repro.label: r for computer vision recomputed on Ho and Whitfill's own inputs (output over input growth)

e9-cv-r-spec-max.label: r for computer vision, labour only: highest value across input specifications and output trends

e9-cv-r-spec-min.label: r for computer vision, labour only: lowest value across input specifications and output trends

e9-cv-share-crit.label: compute's share of research input above which the fixed-compute loop gain for computer vision is below 1 (central refit)

e9-cv-share-crit-max.label: the same critical share for computer vision: highest value across all specifications

e9-cv-share-r1.label: compute's share above which r itself (on the composite input, compute's growth counted) is below 1 for computer vision

e9-cv-share-safe.label: smallest compute share at which the 95th percentile of the fixed-compute loop gain for computer vision is below 1

e9-lm-gk.label: growth of training compute in language models over the same window (notable models, natural log a year), the compute proxy

e9-lm-gk-crit.label: growth of research compute below which the language-model loop at fixed compute is above 1 at a = 0.67 (central refit, natural log a year)
e9-lm-gk-crit.note: the published correction is the case where compute grew as fast as the labour proxy

e9-lm-gk-se.label: standard error of that compute growth for language models

e9-lm-k-fixed.label: loop gain at fixed compute for language models, K = (1 - a) r, at compute's share a = 0.67, with compute's historical growth counted

e9-lm-k-fixed-above1.label: share of draws for language models with the fixed-compute loop gain above 1 at a = 0.67

e9-lm-k-fixed-hi.label: loop gain at fixed compute for language models at a = 0.67, 95th percentile of the draws

e9-lm-k-published-correction.label: the published compute correction applied to our labour-only refit for language models, r (1 - a) at a = 0.67, which leaves compute's growth out
e9-lm-k-published-correction.note: the ledger's corrected median from Ho and Whitfill's r is dyn-r-lm-corrected

e9-lm-k-spec-max.label: loop gain at fixed compute for language models at a = 0.67: highest value across all specifications

e9-lm-r-labour.label: r for language models, our refit with research labour as the only input: steady-state ratio of output growth to input growth (today's OpenAlex counts, yearly flows, fitted slope)

e9-lm-r-labour-above1.label: share of the labour-only draws for language models with r above 1

e9-lm-r-labour-hi.label: r for language models, labour only, 95th percentile of the same draws

e9-lm-r-labour-lo.label: r for language models, labour only, 5th percentile of draws over the output trend's uncertainty and the input slope

e9-lm-r-repro.label: r for language models recomputed on Ho and Whitfill's own inputs (output over input growth)

e9-lm-r-spec-max.label: r for language models, labour only: highest value across input specifications and output trends

e9-lm-r-spec-min.label: r for language models, labour only: lowest value across input specifications and output trends

e9-lm-share-crit.label: compute's share of research input above which the fixed-compute loop gain for language models is below 1 (central refit)

e9-lm-share-crit-max.label: the same critical share for language models: highest value across all specifications

e9-lm-share-r1.label: compute's share above which r itself (on the composite input, compute's growth counted) is below 1 for language models

e9-lm-share-safe.label: smallest compute share at which the 95th percentile of the fixed-compute loop gain for language models is below 1

e9-lp-r-ours.label: r for linear programming with today's OpenAlex works counts instead of unique authors (labour only)

e9-lp-r-repro.label: r for linear programming recomputed on Erdil et al.'s inputs (naive), against their published naive 1.51

e9-moore-r-min.label: r for Moore's Law: lowest across Bloom et al.'s six R&D series

e9-openai-gl.label: growth of OpenAI's staff, 2022 to 2025, refitted from Ho and Whitfill's files (natural log a year)

e9-openai-r.label: r at OpenAI at Ho and Whitfill's central compute share 0.67

e9-openai-r-compute.label: r at OpenAI with compute as the only input (a = 1)

e9-openai-r-labour.label: r at OpenAI with staff as the only input (a = 0), efficiency growing 3x a year
